title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.
 The Customer Support Team helps customers improve their experience using Plaid Products through collaborative issue resolution.
 We are:
 Customer-obsessed
 Problem Solvers
 Technically Savvy
 Collaborative
 Today, Plaid Support ensures our customers' applications can help their consumers live their best financial lives by ensuring our products continue to operate as expected. We investigate the root cause of integration issues, quantify their scope and impact, and when we can’t fix them ourselves, we work with our Go-to-Market, Engineering, and Product teams to reach a solution.
 As we continue to grow, we’re looking for Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to join the team to help us balance the needs of customers, users and internal stakeholders, while navigating critical technical issues. In this role, you will manage issues from their first symptom to their eventual resolution, communicating with our customers and internal stakeholders throughout the process. People who succeed in this role tend to be empathetic, collaborative, technically minded, and most importantly - customer-centric. title: GTM Associate
description:
GTM Associate
 London, 4x days per week in-office
 Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth.
 About Vega
 Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
 Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 Who we are
 We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 How we do it

title: (Senior) Finance Manager (all genders)
description:
At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams.
We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.
If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet!
 Your mission:
 As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO.
 This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function.
 Your responsibilities:
 Own our HGB-compliant accounting: run the month-end and year-end close and deliver accurate, timely financial statements with our external accountants.
 Run financial operations end-to-end: accounts receivable and payable, tax-compliant invoicing, payment…

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Role Join a SaaS product engineering team building AI-powered tools for certification, inspection, and compliance workflows. You will work directly with customer operations to turn real-world processes into reliable software that improves how these workflows are carried out.
 What You'll Do Work alongside customers to understand how certification, inspection, and compliance processes operate in practice.
 Lead customer calls, write product specifications, and build full-stack systems from user interface through backend, data model, and AI components.
 Own product areas from discovery through production delivery, collaborating directly with company founders.
 Ship software quickly, observe how customers use it, and refine it based on feedback.
 Use judgment to distinguish customer requests that apply broadly from those that are specific to one workflow.
 Analyze customer documents and real-world outputs to develop AI-enabled workflows for scheduling, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence.
 What We're Looking For Three to six years of software or product engineering experience, with a record of building and shipping production systems.
 Full-stack development skills, including Python backend services, TypeScript, React or a similar modern frontend framework, and data modeling.
 Experience integrating AI or machine learning systems into production products, including LLMs or document intelligence.
 Experience building products or systems from the ground up, ideally in an early-stage or founding engineering environment.
 Comfort working directly with customers and translating operational needs into durable software.
 Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to work across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure.
 Compensation & Benefits Base salary: £100,000 to £160,000 annually. UK visa sponsorship is available.
 Location On-site, five days per week in London, United Kingdom.
